entity_name: GMAHK Rinegetan (Gereja Masehi Advent Hari Ketujuh Jemaat Rinegetan)
theme_strategy: Light default with high contrast Warm Slate/Navy and Sabbath Amber, supporting optional Dark Sabbath Mode

typography.advent_sans_fallback_stack: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Noto Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

scale.display_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight sm:leading-none
scale.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

rules.standard_columns_1_to_6: Used for editorial content, narrative text, schedules, department grids, form elements, and main layout structure.
rules.sabbath_column_7: The dedicated Sabbath Column representing rest, holiness, visual spotlight, high-impact photography, texture, or the Adventist Symbol lockup. Must never be overcrowded with dense body paragraphs.
rules.mobile_behavior: Collapses intelligently to a single fluid column with a dedicated Sabbath accent border/banner at the top or bottom of key sections.

css_classes.container: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-7 gap-6 lg:gap-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
css_classes.sabbath_column: lg:col-span-1 bg-amber-500/10 border-l border-amber-500/20 p-4 rounded-r-xl flex flex-col justify-between

visual_enhancers.hero_animation: Line-by-line masked kinetic text reveal on initial load using framer-motion
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial text ticker displaying weekly Sabbath theme and Bible verse
visual_enhancers.photography_style: Warm ambient lighting, spotlight frames, subtle 1px amber/gold borders, real community interactions
visual_enhancers.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling initialized globally
visual_enhancers.interactive_micro_states: Hover lift -translate-y-1, amber glow shadow, crisp focus ring (ring-2 ring-amber-500)

navigation.brand_lockup: Official Adventist Flame & Bible Symbol + 'GMAHK Rinegetan' text lockup according to Adventist.design guidelines

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: All buttons, navigation items, cards, input fields, schedule blocks, and interactive modals MUST contain explicit role-based data-testid attributes.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Full tab ordering, visible outline focus indicators (ring-2 ring-amber-500 ring-offset-2), aria-expanded, aria-controls for mobile menu.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Seventh-day Adventist Creation Grid structure (7 columns on desktop, Column 7 as Sabbath Spotlight).
Use official Adventist identity lockup with logo symbol and GMAHK Rinegetan title without modifying logo geometry.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for kinetic text reveals.
Add data-testid to every interactive component across all 7 pages.
Ensure WITA timezone details (Minahasa/North Sulawesi) for Sabbath schedule: 08.45 WITA Sekolah Sabat, 10.15 WITA Khotbah Sabat.
